oneFourFive.name: Home and back
oneFourFive.feel: The plainest, strongest song shape there is.

oneFourOneFive.name: Call and answer
oneFourOneFive.feel: Steps out, comes home, then leaves the door open.

oneFiveOne.name: Two chords
oneFiveOne.feel: Home and away, like a folk song or a lullaby.

fourChords.name: The four chords
fourChords.feel: The sound of a thousand pop songs: bright and singable.

sadFour.name: The four chords, wistful
sadFour.feel: The same four, starting on the minor one: tender.

dooWop.name: Doo-wop
dooWop.feel: The fifties street-corner sound, made for voices.

oneFourSixFive.name: Hopeful pop
oneFourSixFive.feel: Climbs and leans forward into the next line.

fourOneFiveSix.name: Lift-off
fourOneFiveSix.feel: Starts away from home, so it soars: a chorus favourite.

minorFourAche.name: The bittersweet turn
minorFourAche.feel: A major chord turns minor: a lovely ache.

gospel.name: Gospel
gospel.feel: Leans into the four chord, then sighs into its minor, like a church choir.

twoFiveOne.name: The jazz cadence
twoFiveOne.feel: Smooth and inevitable, the way standards land.

turnaround.name: The turnaround
turnaround.feel: Spins round and round for swinging close harmony.

andalusian.name: Flamenco steps
andalusian.feel: Walks down step by step: dramatic and dark.

epicMinor.name: Epic minor
epicMinor.feel: Big, open and a little heroic.

minorHome.name: Minor home
minorHome.feel: A plain minor song shape, with a strong pull home.

minorLift.name: Minor, rising
minorLift.feel: Minor, but lifting towards the light.

canon.name: The Canon
canon.feel: Pachelbel's famous walk: graceful and classical.

circle.name: Round the circle
circle.feel: Each chord pulls to the next, all the way home.

mixolydian.name: Folk rock
mixolydian.feel: A chord borrowed from just below home gives it an open, Celtic air.

dorianVamp.name: Dorian groove
dorianVamp.feel: Two chords rocking gently: minor with a bright side.

risingMinor.name: Rising to minor
risingMinor.feel: Climbs two steps up into home: a minor chorus that soars.

minorPlea.name: Minor plea
minorPlea.feel: Starts away from home and circles round, longing.

minorSway.name: Minor sway
minorSway.feel: Rocks between home and the chords below it: moody and big.

minorBright.name: Minor, sunlit
minorBright.feel: A minor song with a bright major four: Dorian sunshine.

royalRoad.name: The royal road
royalRoad.feel: Soars from the four chord: a chorus that takes off.

climb.name: The climb
climb.feel: Four, five, then home at the top: a big landing.

party.name: Party loop
party.feel: Three chords round and round: hands in the air.

barbershop.name: Barbershop
barbershop.feel: The ringing chain of sevenths barbershop quartets love.

why.lift: Starts somewhere brighter, so it lifts off the verse.
why.contrast: Changes colour and pace, so the chorus stands apart.
why.classic: A pairing songwriters often reach for.
why.bridgeFour: Leans away to the four chord, then builds to the five.
why.bridgeMinor: A minor detour before the last chorus.
why.bridgeFlatSeven: A surprising chord from below home, then back toward the chorus.
why.bridgeMinorFour: A bittersweet minor four, then back.
why.bridgeRelative: Opens into the relative major, then turns back.
why.bridgeSixth: Floats up through the sixth and seventh.
why.bridgeTwo: Steps sideways to the two chord, gentle and searching.
why.bridgeThree: Drifts through the minor three and six before turning toward home.
why.prechorus: Builds up to the chorus, so it lands with a lift.
why.bridgeBlues: The rhythm and blues bridge: four, home, four, then five.

cause.blockedBody: Your browser, or your device, said no to the mic for this site. It's quick to allow: follow the steps below, then tap Try again.
cause.notFoundBody: Plug in a mic or headphones with one, or check the one you use is switched on, then tap Try again.
cause.inUseBody: Another app may be using it, such as a call, a voice note or another tab. Close that, then tap Try again. On an iPhone, if it still won't start, close {browser} completely (swipe it away in the app switcher) and open it again; if even that fails, restarting the phone fixes it.

cause.inAppBody: You're in {app}'s own browser, which often can't use the mic. Tap the menu (··· or the share button) and choose Open in browser, or copy the link and paste it into Safari or Chrome.

cause.unsupportedBody: Open stackapella.com in Safari, Chrome, Edge or Firefox, up to date. Copy the link to take it with you.
cause.otherBody: Something got in the way. Try again; if it still fails, the steps below allow the mic, and Details shows what the browser said.
cause.blockedShort: Stackapella needs to hear you sing. Allow it in {browser}, then try again.

platform.iosOther: An app's own browser on iPhone

iosSafari.one: Tap the page menu at the edge of the address bar (it shows aA, or ··· on newer iOS).
iosSafari.four: Still asked or blocked? Open the Settings app, tap Apps, then Safari, then Microphone (under Settings for Websites), and choose Allow or Ask.

iosBrowser.one: Open the Settings app, tap Apps, then {browser}.
iosBrowser.three: Come back here and tap Try again. When {browser} asks, tap Allow.

iosApp.one: Open the Settings app, tap Apps, then Safari, then Microphone, and choose Allow or Ask.
iosApp.two: Close Stackapella completely: swipe up from the bottom, pause, then swipe it away.
iosApp.three: Open it again from your Home Screen and tap Allow when asked.

iosOther.one: Tap the menu (··· or the share button) and choose Open in Safari, or Open in browser.
iosOther.two: No such choice? Tap Copy link above, open Safari, and paste it into the address bar.

androidChrome.one: Tap the icon at the left of the address bar (two sliders, or a lock).
androidChrome.three: Don't see it? Tap ⋮, then Settings, Site settings, Microphone, and allow stackapella.com.
androidChrome.four: Still blocked? Open Android Settings, then Apps, Chrome, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow.

samsung.one: Tap the menu (≡), then Settings, then Sites and downloads, then Site permissions.
samsung.two: Tap Microphone, and allow stackapella.com (take it off the blocked list).
samsung.three: Still blocked? Open Android Settings, then Apps, Samsung Internet, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow.

androidFirefox.one: Tap the lock at the left of the address bar.
androidFirefox.three: Still blocked? Open Android Settings, then Apps, Firefox, Permissions, Microphone, and choose Allow.

chrome.one: Click the icon at the far left of the address bar.
chrome.two: Turn on **Microphone**. No switch? Open **Site settings** and choose **Allow**.

edge.one: Click the lock at the left of the address bar.
edge.two: Click **Permissions for this site**, and set **Microphone** to **Allow**.

firefox.one: Click the crossed-out microphone in the address bar.
firefox.two: Click the × next to **Blocked**, then Try again and choose **Allow** when Firefox asks.

safari.one: In the menu bar, choose **Safari**, then **Settings**, then **Websites**.

mac.two: Turn on your browser. The Mac may ask you to quit and reopen it.

windows.two: Turn on **Microphone access**, and **Let desktop apps access your microphone**.
